title: Playboy December 2006 Cindy Margolis Stephen King Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Front cover has light scuffs and small white specks across the image (see close-up). Back cover clean. Spine intact.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, December 2006 - Gala Christmas Issue. Original $6.99 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Cover: web goddess Cindy Margolis.

Cover features: new fiction by Stephen King; Dixie Chicks interview; Samuel L. Jackson 20Q; Gore Vidal on Al Gore; annual music poll; holiday tuxes; J.D. Salinger's secret sweetheart; David Mamet's fight night; Lauren Weisberger, Junot Diaz, Jane Smiley, Jay McInerney, A.S. Byatt.

Back cover: Absolut vodka ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
